steps.title: Open the Cockpit
steps.narration: We start at the Cockpit, where traders watch live market activity. Let's open the dashboard.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit page shows the watch controls and live chart.

steps.title: Select Simulated data
steps.narration: We start with simulated data, which lets us test the system without a live broker connection.
steps.point_out: The data source selector now shows 'Simulated' selected.

steps.title: Enter ticker and watch
steps.narration: We'll watch SIM-BIDABS, a simulated ticker. Enter it and click Watch to start receiving observations.
steps.point_out: A ticker input field appears where you can type the symbol.

steps.title: Type the ticker symbol
steps.narration: Let's type SIM-BIDABS, the symbol we want to observe.

steps.title: Click Watch to start observing
steps.narration: Now we click Watch to start receiving live observations about this ticker's market activity.
steps.point_out: The watch control starts loading, and the status changes to 'live' when ready.

steps.title: Pause the observation
steps.narration: Once watching is active, you can pause to freeze the observation snapshot at this exact moment—a useful way to inspect a market moment without new events changing the state.
steps.point_out: The Pause button is now visible, and clicking it freezes the observation.

steps.title: Resume observing
steps.narration: Resume resumes watching—the observation stays consistent, but live events flow through again.
steps.point_out: The Resume button was clicked and the live status resumes.

steps.title: Visit Structure to see market levels
steps.narration: The observation contract powers the entire system. Let's verify that the Structure page still works correctly, showing market levels and trade setups.
steps.point_out: The Structure page loads with market level analysis.
